user.title: Add a Govee H7015
user.description: Pick a discovered H7015 from the list, or enter its MAC address manually.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a Govee H7015.

device_unreachable.title: Govee H7015 is unreachable
device_unreachable.description: The Govee H7015 ({mac}) has not been reachable via Bluetooth for an extended period. This could be because the lights are powered off, the Bluetooth adapter is out of range, or another device (phone with Govee app) is connected. Try: verify lights are powered on, close the Govee Home app on your phone, check Bluetooth adapter status, or add an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

set_bulb.name: Set bulb color
set_bulb.description: Set the color of a single bulb on a Govee H7015 string light.

snapshot_scene.name: Snapshot current colors as scene
snapshot_scene.description: Save the current per-bulb colors as a HA scene you can recall later.
